_about: The puzzles solved by doing (#104; docs/PUZZLES.md, src/core/puzzles.js). A puzzle is a side quest: a person offers it on some days (every: one day in this many, by the seed and the day; after: a flag that must be set first), it is optional, and nothing in the story waits for it. Its person has a small mark of a side quest (look mark-side), not the star of the story. No count of mistakes and no score of mastery for the puzzle itself; skill: the skill event of its math, where it has one. Each line is spoken, and a wave gives the next hint (hints, in order; a hint is never a question). era, tale (true for a tale told of a real person), who, and source (a published record: book or article, with its page; page null and checked false: not checked yet; book null: a record to find, docs/QUESTIONS.md). Places are cells from the top left corner of a map object (anchor). ferry (the river-crossing puzzle): the landings (a, b: the water spots of the boat; landA, landB: where the hero steps off), the bank spots of the things (spotsA, spotsB), the traveler (at), the pairs that cannot stay alone (pairs: [eater, eaten, scene]), and the gift. pots (the water-pouring puzzle at the well): the pots (sizes, in bowls), the need of each grade (levels: grades from, sizes, need, skill), and the places. tales: the tales of later eras, data only.
